items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: I said, well, Downs, I said, Baby, I'm going to come out and I'm going to play some dances with you. I said, okay. Downs started kicking rhythm in me.

ctx.x: He said, because one baby said, I want you to meet so-and-so, a drummer. And he looked at me and he winked. That mean, don't let him get on the band side, because you'll catch the devil up there.
So, all right. He said, Dad. I said, well, Downs, I said, Baby, I'm going to come out and I'm going to play some dances with you. I said, okay. Downs started kicking rhythm in me. Soft.

And he could take those two sticks and just take them from the edge of his drum and look like this pan and paper. And keep them down at the same time. And he had a way. All that stuff. And me, I'm, you know, I'm just killing myself, drumming, because I love rhythm. I looked down and played a second. I said, sit down. Get down. I said, you're going to kill me. This is Saturday night.
